scripts.build:production: env-cmd -f .env.production react-scripts build && cp public/.htaccess build/.htaccess && cp public/sw.js build/sw.js && node scripts/post-build.js
scripts.build:cpanel: npm run build:production && npm run optimize:cpanel
scripts.build:analyze: npm run build:production && npx webpack-bundle-analyzer build/static/js/*.js
scripts.optimize:cpanel: echo 'Build completed for cPanel deployment. Upload the build folder contents to your cPanel public_html directory.'
